payload.intro: My back aches just watching you hack away at herbs with rusty garden shears!
payload.prompt: Which enchanted tool increases your herb yield by 10%?

payload.intro: Good labour doesn't come cheap, adventurer, and neither do my colleagues.
payload.prompt: What does a gardener charge to watch over a growing Magic tree?

payload.intro: I just packed a Tier 5 seed pack for a farmer who actually bothered finishing their contract.
payload.prompt: Which of these seeds is least likely to be in a Tier 5 seed pack?

payload.intro: Don't just stand there trampling my petunias! I have a clipboard full of work to assign!
payload.prompt: Which tier of Farming contract asks you to grow Kwuarm?

payload.intro: The mighty Hespori rests in a cave in my Guild. Its roots can snap a man in two, and you look like you'd faint at the first sign of poison.
Only the master tier of my guild grows this one. It takes over 13 hours, and fletchers covet its bark.
payload.prompt: Which tree's bark is used to make battlestaves?

payload.intro: My gardeners are happy to look after your trees while you're off questing, provided you bring the right produce!
payload.prompt: Match each tree to the payment a gardener asks to watch over it.
payload.explanation: Oak takes a basket of tomatoes, willow a basket of apples, maple a basket of oranges, yew 10 cactus spines and palm 15 papayas.

payload.intro: My guild is divided into three tiers so novices don't track mud into the redwood greenhouse!
payload.prompt: Sort these Farming Guild patches by which tier of the guild they are located in.
payload.explanation: The level 45 west wing holds allotments, flowers, bushes, cacti and trees; the level 65 north wing holds the herb patch, anima patch and Hespori cave; the level 85 east wing holds fruit trees, spirit trees, celastrus and the redwood tree.

payload.intro: Supercompost is fine, adventurer, but a handful of ash from Fossil Island makes it far better!
payload.prompt: What material mined on Fossil Island is added to supercompost to turn it into ultracompost?
payload.explanation: Adding 2 volcanic ash to a bucket of supercompost (or 50 to a full compost bin) turns it into ultracompost.

payload.intro: Nothing breaks a farmer's heart like arriving at a patch of dead ranarrs. Thankfully, a few patches in Gielinor never catch disease!
payload.prompt: Which three of these herb patches can stay completely disease-free once unlocked?
payload.explanation: The Troll Stronghold, Weiss, Hosidius (after the Easy Kourend & Kebos Diary) and Harmony Island (or Civitas illa Fortis at Champion rank) herb patches are protected from disease.

payload.intro: Don't lug buckets of compost around in your backpack! The Tool Leprechauns will hold hundreds of them for you.
payload.prompt: What is the maximum number of regular buckets of each compost type a Tool Leprechaun can store?
payload.explanation: Tool Leprechauns can store up to 1,000 empty buckets, 1,000 compost, 1,000 supercompost and 1,000 ultracompost.

payload.intro: Keep tending your trees and one day a little wooden companion might uproot itself and follow you around!
payload.prompt: What is the name of the Farming skilling pet?
payload.explanation: Tangleroot is the Farming skilling pet, whose appearance can be changed by feeding it different seeds.
